action_inputs.description: JSON object of Terraform variable name/value pairs to apply. Pre-filled with this deployment's current variable values; edit any you want to change. Only variables this deployment already manages may be set here (unknown keys are rejected before anything is written); removing a key leaves that variable unchanged. Do not paste secrets into this plaintext field; sensitive variables are excluded and rejected if added.
action_inputs.label: Parameters (JSON)
action_inputs.name: parameters

description: Day-2 action: generic JSON variable update for an HCP Terraform No-Code Module deployment. Re-presents the deployment's current variable values as one editable JSON object (pre-filled from the tfc_var_* mirrors), rejects any key the deployment does not already manage, any sensitive key, and any non-object payload, fails fast if the workspace has a non-final run pending, snapshots the prior values, upserts the FULL variable set, and runs with a human plan-approval pause: 'Continue Job' approves and applies, canceling rejects -- the run is discarded and the workspace variables are reverted to the snapshot.
name: Update Variables
